settings.description_override: A playful nod to equestrian style. The Horse Charm adds a little movement and personality to a favorite bag, with a familiar silhouette that feels collected rather than formal. A small detail for the woman who always makes a look her own.
settings.fact_detail: A softly padded profile and carefully shaped details give the little horse its character.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: A horse-shaped bag charm with attachment and decorative details that vary by colorway. Follow the selected color’s photographs for the exact finish and shape.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid prolonged moisture and store without compressing the padded shape.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
